message.text: I will read proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto to identify every RPC and its backend implementation file.

q14.
ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut — server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go

Those RPCs are defined on `ShortcutService` in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` and implemented as `APIV1Service` methods in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.
